result.title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
result.summary: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative with respect to the probability of selecting it, and we evaluate joint edits as single candidates because their changes interact. Schema Descent instantiates the method for graph schemas. In experiments on large documents, each a bundle of research papers, the updated knowledge cards and graph schemas obtain higher mean Answer F1 on held-out generated questions than their initial structures, with schema gains in every document. On human questions, mean F1 rises for schemas and falls for cards: the updated structures serve the kind of question they were learned from.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究「自结构化学习」：在问答反馈下迭代改写持久知识库的结构（图 schema 或链接文档组织），每轮提出结构编辑、重建知识库，仅在留出问题上的学习损失下降时保留，并用对候选编辑的随机化把损失变化表达为选择概率的导数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散结构编辑＋用采样近似梯度做贡献分配、并考察对其他问题的泛化」可能为 LVR 中离散决策（如 THINK/LOOK/STOP 或轨迹片段）的信用分配与证据组织提供可核查线索，但论文本身面向文本知识库检索，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。
